title: Let confirmed evaluation refusals settle even if presentation history reaches its cap
outcome: Presentation-history capacity cannot veto a confirmed terminal refusal: the refusal and submission disposition settle durably while an unavailable presentation entry is skipped or explicitly flagged.
acceptance: With an injected full view collection or per-key presentation cap, a confirmed refusal still settles durably and resets its open write instead of becoming Unconfirmed on the next submit; ordinary refusal history and unknown-outcome controls retain their distinctions.
